review_context.scope: Backend owner settings panel, project-detail mounting, scoped stylesheet, semantic theme/shared controls, typed API connection and matching local operational copy. Source-only review against provisional DESIGN.md.
passed_observations: All introduced component colors use semantic roles; fonts inherit the shared system. Status uses words rather than color alone.
Existing Button/Input/Failure/Loading components and environment labels are reused; no separate visual component system was introduced.

French owner copy consistently describes desired settings, prepared/disabled/held/stale state and disconnected hosted runtime. No invented health/resource metric or provider qualification is displayed.

Environment selection remounts settings by cell; the form resets against backend/project/environment revisions. Owner passkey freshness and held state disable mutations, while strict server revision checks remain authoritative.
The integration remains inside project details and uses explicit labels, a named form/region, error/loading feedback and status announcements.
Scoped mobile rules collapse fields to one column, allow multiline buttons and stretch actions; min-width:0 and bounded panel padding support the existing layout.
The provisional identity remains inexpensive to rebrand: semantic colors and inherited typography are preserved, with no baked raster branding or added motion.
Typed owner API/client and UI consistently keep runtimeConnected false; configuration saves cannot create providers, expose application material or activate a recovered destination.

not_reviewed: No browser rendering, screenshot inspection, measured clipping/contrast, assistive-technology or keyboard run was performed in this read-only source review; actual browser evidence belongs to GAUNTLET/root.

The provisional identity has no complete semantic spacing/typography scale. COH-01/02 were applied to existing semantic roles and established sizing conventions, not used to invent a new design-system migration.
There is no separate formal voice matrix/naming inventory beyond the current DESIGN.md and existing console language; copy was compared with those actual sources.
The owner view intentionally describes preparation/disconnection; hosted health, live application use, remote qualification and full platform accessibility certification are outside this artifact.
